title: Path simplification: Ramer-Douglas-Peucker for pencil tool smoothing
description: Freehand pencil drawing produces paths with too many anchor points. Add a path simplification step in packages/core/src/engine/shapes.ts using the Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm: (1) Add simplifyPath(points: Array<{x:number,y:number}>, epsilon: number): Array<{x:number,y:number}> function that reduces the number of points while preserving shape; (2) Add smoothPath(path: ShapePath): ShapePath that converts sharp-corner line segments to quadratic bezier curves using Catmull-Rom spline approximation — this gives the pencil tool its characteristic smooth look; (3) Wire simplifyPath+smoothPath into the pencil tool output — after a pencil stroke finishes, apply simplifyPath(pts, 2.0) then smoothPath to the path before creating the shape; (4) Add a createSimplifiedPencilShape(points, fill, stroke) helper that applies both transforms. Add tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/simplify.test.ts: verify simplifyPath removes collinear points, verify epsilon=0 removes nothing, verify a diagonal line with intermediate collinear points reduces to 2 points, verify smoothPath produces curve segments. Only touches packages/core/src/engine/ — no authoring-ui changes.
